name: colchicina
notes: Alkaloid from Colchicum autumnale and a microtubule drug: it binds the colchicine site at the alpha/beta intradimer interface of tubulin and inhibits polymerisation. Affinity was measured against the ISOLATED alpha/beta dimer (Kd 58 nM to 3.7 uM; ChEMBL CHEMBL107), which makes it a better docking control than taxol, whose Kd exists only for the assembled microtubule and whose volume inflates the score. Co-crystal 1SA0 carries the analogue DAMA-colchicine (CCD CN2); what is docked here is free colchicine.
